renderer: Native Makepad module; scene contracts rendered responsively, not L0 screen images

native_components.icons: bundled SVG Icon or catalog artwork in Image

actions.action: Open built-in or verified installed app; otherwise review permissions
actions.retry: Clear current filters or refresh verified catalog
actions.refresh: Refresh verified catalog and retry artwork

raster_policy: Only declared artwork; atlas and reference screenshots never enter the runtime resources.
deviations: No iOS status bar or home indicator; host supplies system chrome.
Preview apps are included built-ins, never fake store installs.
Trail Notes exists only in the optional signed local validation fixture; it is never a bundled live listing.
Use actual OctoSense Photos sample photography as editorial art; do not present generated mock maps as real app screenshots.
Native responsive widths and scrolling replace atlas fixed geometry.
V1 is English; full flow runner hardcodes English/Chinese, so its atlas.py intake is used directly without claiming bilingual/compiled-L0 acceptance.
